description: This file defines the 'Zone' class which manages CRUD operations and data retrieval for 'zone' entities in the localisation module of an OpenCart admin system. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, fetching individual, multiple, and total zones, as well as retrieving zones by country ID.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Represents the model for geographical zones within the localisation module, providing CRUD operations and data retrieval functions for zones.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Inserts a new zone record into the database with data provided, then clears the zone cache and returns the new zone ID.

methods.name: editZone
methods.description: Updates an existing zone record identified by zone_id with new data, then clears the zone cache.

methods.name: deleteZone
methods.description: Deletes the zone record identified by zone_id from the database and clears the zone cache.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a single zone by ID, returning it as an associative array.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieves a list of zone records matching optional filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Fetches all active zones associated with a specific country ID.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Returns the total count of zones, optionally filtered by name, country, or code.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the total number of zones for a specific country ID.
